subject: [PATCH 11/60] fork: check cached stack locality only on common memory nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The original author posted the same message twice, once as a regular email and once via B4 Relay. The content of both messages is identical.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the fork code to only check for stack locality on common memory nodes when caching a freed stack. It ensures that CPUs on non-common memory nodes can still cache stacks from other nodes, similar to how they handle memoryless nodes.
